clusters.label: COVID-19 vaccines harm fertility or pregnancy

fact_checks.matched_claim: “Head of Pfizer Research: Covid Vaccine is Female Sterilization”
Pfizer BioNTech Covid-19 vaccine causes women sterilization
GlaxoSmithKline's COVID-19 vaccine contains ingredients that will cause infertility.
fact_checks.claimant: Posts on Facebook and Instagram, David Icke's website

fact_checks.matched_claim: The COVID-19 vaccines, specifically the ones that use mRNA, cause infertility.
"All males who have been vaccinated" against COVID-19 "are effectively sterile."
“Forcing” young women to have Covid-19 vaccines is “almost certain” to lead to increased stillbirths, miscarriages, disabled children and infertility.
fact_checks.rating: There is no evidence for this. Yellow Card and VAERS reporting is cited as the source of this claim, but the data from these systems does not prove a link.

fact_checks.matched_claim: The Covid vaccines could harm female fertility
fact_checks.rating: Experts say these claims are unfounded. There is no "plausible biological mechanism" by which the vaccine could affect your fertility, says Prof Lucy Chappell, a professor in obstetrics at King's College London.

fact_checks.matched_claim: A study shows the Covid vaccine accumulating in the ovaries.
fact_checks.rating: This is false and misreads a study submitted to the Japanese regulator.

fact_checks.matched_claim: A vaccine monitoring site shows Covid vaccines cause miscarriages.
fact_checks.rating: False claim. There were indeed miscarriages reported in these databases - they are unfortunately common events - but this does not mean the jab caused them.

fact_checks.matched_claim: Covid caccines could attack the placenta.
fact_checks.claimant: Contained in a widely shared petition from Michael Yeadon
fact_checks.rating: There is no evidence to support this claim and now studies are emerging to help disprove it.

fact_checks.matched_claim: COVID-19 vaccines threaten people's fertility, no matter their type of reproductive systems.

clusters.label: Vaccine injury reports show mass vaccine deaths

fact_checks.matched_claim: The number of “vaccine related deaths” in the United States in 2021 surpasses that of the past decade

“The fact of the matter is it looks like natural immunity is as strong if not stronger than vaccinated immunity. ... There is a risk to the vaccine. Again, it’s very small, but there are some pretty serious side effects, including death. We are already over 5,200 deaths reported on the VAERS system. That’s a CDC, FDA’s early warning system.”
“The Vaccine Adverse Event Recording System shows that 5,946 people have died because of the” COVID-19 vaccine.
“Hundreds of thousands died after taking the advice of these celebrities,” who are “aiding and abetting mass murder” by advocating COVID-19 vaccination.

A graph from Vaccine Adverse Event Reporting System (VAERS) published on July 30, 2021 reveals that 12,366 people died upon receiving COVID-19 jabs. Most of the reported deaths were Pfizer-vaccinated and males.
US data shows problems with specific Covid-19 vaccine batches
"The Biden administration plan would kill 5,248 children via Pfizer mRNA shots in order to save 45 children from dying of coronavirus."

Deaths from vaccines have totaled 1,621 from Johnson & Johnson, 4,799 from Moderna, 13,039 from Pfizer and 73 from unknown vaccines. And this is an undercount because “only 1% of deaths are reported.”
The reported number of COVID-19 vaccine deaths in VAERS undercounts the actual number of deaths. According to a Harvard study, only 1% of deaths are reported.
There have been more deaths from COVID-19 vaccines than deaths from the actual virus.
